codeSystems.name: FHIR4EyesCarePlanCategoryCS
codeSystems.title: FHIR4Eyes Care Plan Category Code System
codeSystems.description:
Proposed FHIR4Eyes-only codes for care plan category, not yet bound to an
external terminology. See the Profiles page of this guide for the design rationale.

codeSystems.name: FHIR4EyesCS
codeSystems.title: FHIR4Eyes Code System
codeSystems.description:
Local, laterality-neutral codes for ophthalmic observations and components
defined by FHIR4Eyes where no suitable side-neutral LOINC or SNOMED CT code has been
verified. Open to replacement as external codes become available.
